人教版选择性必修 1「自然地理基础」· 第四章第三节「海—气相互作用」（p.72: PEP Elective 1 "Foundations of Physical Geography" · Chapter 4, Section 3 "Ocean–atmosphere interaction" (pp.72–76)
海—气相互作用与厄尔尼诺、拉尼娜: Ocean–Atmosphere Interaction, El Niño and La Niña
海温异常 → 温差 → 环流 → 降水: SST anomaly → temperature contrast → circulation → rainfall
秘鲁沿海常年干旱，为什么 2016 年底海水一暖，就下起了暴雨、还死了近百人？: Coastal Peru is dry all year. Why, when the sea warmed in late 2016, did torrential rain come and kill nearly a hundred people?
海洋给大气水汽与热量（潜热是主要途径），大气用风驱动表层海水: The ocean gives the atmosphere water vapor and heat (latent heat is the main route); the atmosphere drives surface water with wind
正常年份：西岸暖、东岸冷（冷水上涌），东西温差 +8.0 ℃: Normal years: warm in the west, cold in the east (upwelling), east–west contrast +8.0 ℃
温差驱动大气热力环流：西侧上升、东侧下沉，信风自东向西: The contrast drives a thermal circulation: rising in the west, sinking in the east, trade winds from east to west
东侧海温异常升高 → 温差减小、信风减弱 → 东侧下沉减弱甚至转为上升: Eastern SST rises abnormally → contrast shrinks, trades weaken → sinking in the east weakens or even turns to rising
东岸（秘鲁、智利）由旱转涝，西岸（印尼）转旱；拉尼娜相反: The east coast (Peru, Chile) goes from drought to flood, the west (Indonesia) turns dry; La Niña is the reverse
印度尼西亚、澳大利亚一侧的暖海面与上空雨云: Warm sea and rain clouds on the Indonesia–Australia side
南美沿岸的冷海面与冷水上涌: Cold sea and upwelling off South America
两岸之间的闭合环流与近地面信风: A closed circulation between the two coasts, with surface trade winds
海洋和大气之间到底在换什么？: What exactly do the ocean and atmosphere exchange?
拖动视角看一圈：西边海面暖、东边沿岸冷，两岸的陆地和一条斜贯的赤道线: Drag the view around: warm sea in the west, a cold coast in the east, land on both sides and a slanting equator line
参考工况（正常年份）：东岸海温 21.5 ℃、东西温差 +8.0 ℃、近地面信风: Reference conditions (normal year): east coast SST 21.5 ℃, east–west contrast +8.0 ℃, surface trade wind 6.00 m/s (east to west); the ocean supplies 87.5 % of atmospheric water vapor and stores 85 % of solar heat in its surface layer
海洋通过蒸发向大气提供水汽——大气中约 87.5 % 的水汽由海洋提供。: The ocean supplies the atmosphere with water vapor by evaporation; about 87.5 % of atmospheric water vapor comes from the ocean.
海洋吸收了到达地表太阳辐射的大部分，并把其中 85 % 的热量储存在海洋表层，再: The ocean absorbs most of the solar radiation reaching the surface and stores 85 % of that heat in its surface layer, passing it to the atmosphere by latent heat and longwave radiation.
海水的蒸发—凝结是海—气热量输送的主要途径；反过来，大气主要通过风向海洋传递动能: Evaporation and condensation of seawater are the main route of ocean-to-air heat transfer; in turn the atmosphere passes kinetic energy to the ocean mainly through wind.
去掉这一步：厄尔尼诺就成了一串没有源头的名词，学生不知道「海水一暖」为什么会牵动: Skip this step and El Niño becomes a string of terms with no source; students won't know why "the sea warming" tugs on the atmosphere.
常考：海洋是大气最主要的水汽来源和热量储存库；大气为海水运动提供动能。: Common exam point: the ocean is the atmosphere's main source of water vapor and its heat reservoir; the atmosphere supplies kinetic energy for seawater motion.
海洋向大气提供水汽与热量（潜热是主要途径），大气通过风向海洋传递动能，驱使其表层: The ocean supplies the atmosphere with water vapor and heat (latent heat being the main route), and the atmosphere passes kinetic energy to the ocean through wind, driving surface water; ocean–atmosphere interaction keeps Earth's water and heat in balance.
为什么东岸比西岸冷那么多？: Why is the east coast so much colder than the west?
把「东岸冷舌涌升强度」从 1.00 拖到 1.20：看东端那支向上弯的箭头变长、: Drag "east coast upwelling strength" from 1.00 to 1.20: the upward-curving arrow at the east end grows longer and the east coast gets colder
东岸海温 21.5 → 19.9 ℃；东西温差 +8.0 → +9.6 ℃；信风: East coast SST 21.5 → 19.9 ℃; east–west contrast +8.0 → +9.6 ℃; trade wind 6.00 → 7.20 m/s (stronger)
东岸比西岸冷，是因为信风把表层暖水吹走、下层冷水上涌。: The east coast is colder than the west because trade winds blow the warm surface water away and cold water wells up from below.
上涌越强，东岸越冷：系数 1.00 → 1.20 时东岸 21.5 → 19.9: The stronger the upwelling, the colder the east coast: with the coefficient at 1.00 → 1.20 the east coast goes 21.5 → 19.9 ℃.
东西温差随之变大（+8.0 → +9.6 ℃），信风也更强（6.00 → 7.2: The east–west contrast grows with it (+8.0 → +9.6 ℃), and the trade winds strengthen (6.00 → 7.20 m/s).
去掉这一步：「东岸为什么冷」只能背结论，后面「厄尔尼诺＝东岸变暖」就没有对照。: Skip this step and "why the east coast is cold" is only a memorized conclusion, leaving no baseline for "El Niño = the east coast warms".
常考：东太平洋沿岸的冷舌由冷水上涌形成，上涌与信风强弱相关。: Common exam point: the cold tongue off the eastern Pacific coast is formed by upwelling, which is linked to the strength of the trade winds.
东岸的冷来自冷水上涌：信风把表层暖水吹走、下层冷水上升；上涌越强，东岸越冷、东西: The east coast's cold comes from upwelling: trade winds blow the warm surface water away and cold water rises from below; the stronger the upwelling, the colder the east coast and the larger the contrast.
两岸的温差，怎么变成天上的环流？: How does the temperature contrast between the coasts become a circulation in the sky?
把这个环流圈补完整：先点西侧那一列气柱（应出现向上箭头），再点东侧那一列（应出现: Complete this circulation loop: first click the air column on the west side (an upward arrow should appear), then the one on the east side (a downward arrow should appear)
西侧上升（+1.000）、东侧下沉（−1.000）、近地面信风 6.00 m/s: Rising in the west (+1.000), sinking in the east (−1.000), surface trades 6.00 m/s from east to west; once both are clicked correctly, the upper branch (west to east) and the surface branch (east to west) fill in and the loop closes
温差 → 环流：西升 · 东沉: Contrast → circulation: rising west · sinking east
近地面信风自东向西: Surface trade winds from east to west
正常年份西侧海水温度较高、气流上升；中东部较低、大气较稳定、气流下沉。: In normal years the western sea is warmer and air rises; the central-eastern sea is cooler, the air more stable, and it sinks.
近地面信风自东向西，把暖水堆到西侧；高空则相反。: Surface trade winds blow from east to west, piling warm water up in the west; aloft the flow is reversed.
四支箭头连成一个闭合环流圈——这就是教材图 4.18 留给学生画的那个环。: The four arrows join into a closed loop, the loop that textbook Fig. 4.18 leaves for students to draw.
去掉这一步：温差与环流之间没有桥，学生只记住「东岸雨多」这类结果。: Skip this step and there is no bridge between contrast and circulation; students only remember results such as "more rain on the east coast".
常考：正常年份西侧上升、东侧下沉，近地面信风自东向西（教材图 4.18、活动第: Common exam point: in normal years air rises in the west and sinks in the east, with surface trades from east to west (textbook Fig. 4.18, activity question 1).
正常年份西侧海水暖、气流上升，东侧海温低、气流下沉；近地面信风自东向西，与高空相: In normal years the western sea is warm and air rises, the eastern sea is cool and air sinks; surface trades blow east to west, opposite to the flow aloft, forming a closed thermal circulation.
facts A2.3 #2、图 4.18 图面；B2.2 ④⑤⑥、B4 D2/D: facts A2.3 #2, Fig. 4.18; B2.2 ④⑤⑥, B4 D2/D3, activity question 1
东岸海水一暖，环流会怎样？: Once the east coast sea warms, what happens to the circulation?
把「赤道中东部海温异常」拖到 +2.4 ℃（1997—98 强厄尔尼诺）：看东侧: Drag "central-eastern SST anomaly" to +2.4 ℃ (the strong 1997–98 El Niño): the eastern color band warms and the air column flips from sinking to rising
东岸海温 21.5 → 23.9 ℃；东西温差 +8.0 → +5.6 ℃；信风: East coast SST 21.5 → 23.9 ℃; contrast +8.0 → +5.6 ℃; trades 6.00 → 4.20 m/s; eastern sinking → rising (+0.600), western rising disappears (0.000); east coast rainfall +72.0 mm/month, west coast −45.0 mm/month; status "El Niño · very strong"
东涝西旱: Floods in the east, drought in the west
有些年份中东部的表层海水异常升高，就是厄尔尼诺现象。: In some years the central-eastern surface water warms abnormally: this is El Niño.
之后东西温差减小（+8.0 → +5.6 ℃），信风减弱（6.00 → 4.20: Then the east–west contrast shrinks (+8.0 → +5.6 ℃) and the trade winds weaken (6.00 → 4.20 m/s).
东侧下沉减弱、甚至转为上升，东岸由旱转涝（+72 mm/月）；西侧上升减弱，转旱: Eastern sinking weakens or even turns to rising, so the east coast goes from drought to flood (+72 mm/month); western rising weakens and it turns dry (−45 mm/month).
去掉这一步：教材导入的秘鲁洪水（p.72）没有解释。: Skip this step and the Peru floods that open the textbook chapter (p.72) go unexplained.
易错：把厄尔尼诺说成「东岸变冷」或「信风反向」——是东岸异常变暖、温差减小、信风: Common mistake: describing El Niño as "the east coast cooling" or "the trades reversing". In fact the east coast warms abnormally, the contrast shrinks and the trades weaken.
厄尔尼诺是赤道附近太平洋中东部表层海水异常升高；它使东西温差减小、信风减弱，东侧: El Niño is an abnormal rise in surface water temperature in the central-eastern equatorial Pacific; it shrinks the east–west contrast and weakens the trades, so eastern sinking weakens or turns to rising, the east coast goes from drought to flood and the west from wet to dry.
到底暖到哪一步，东岸才从「下沉」翻成「上升」？: Exactly how warm must it get before the east coast flips from "sinking" to "rising"?
把海温异常拖到 +1.5 ℃：这一点东侧的下沉刚好消失（两边都不升不沉）: Drag the SST anomaly to +1.5 ℃: at this point the sinking in the east just disappears (neither side rises nor sinks)
东侧下沉消失（0.000）、西侧上升消失（0.000）；两岸降水距平同为 ±45: Eastern sinking disappears (0.000), western rising disappears (0.000); rainfall anomalies on both coasts are ±45.0 mm/month; contrast +6.5 ℃, trades 4.88 m/s; status "El Niño · strong"
教材的原话是「下沉气流减弱或消失，甚至出现上升气流」——中间有一个「消失」的点。: The textbook says "the sinking air weakens or disappears, and rising air may even appear"; there is a "disappears" point in between.
本课把这一点定在 A = +1.5 ℃（课件设定，与「强」档起点对齐）。: This lesson sets that point at A = +1.5 ℃ (a lesson setting, aligned with the start of the "strong" level).
到这一点，两岸的垂直运动都归零、降水距平都是 ±45 mm/月；再暖一点东侧才转: At this point vertical motion on both coasts is zero and rainfall anomalies are ±45 mm/month; only a little warmer and the east side turns to rising.
去掉这一步：学生会以为「一暖就翻」，说不清「减弱」与「反转」的区别。: Skip this step and students think "it flips as soon as it warms", unable to tell "weakening" from "reversal".
易错：把「减弱 / 消失 / 反向」当成一句话——教材写的是三个阶段。: Common mistake: treating "weaken / disappear / reverse" as one phrase; the textbook describes three stages.
东侧下沉「消失」的那一点是海温异常 +1.5 ℃（课件设定）：两岸垂直运动同时归: The point where eastern sinking "disappears" is an SST anomaly of +1.5 ℃ (lesson setting): vertical motion on both coasts drops to zero at once, and only a little warmer does the east side turn to rising.
反过来，东岸更冷会怎样？: The other way round: what if the east coast gets colder?
把海温异常拖到 −2.0 ℃（1973—74 拉尼娜）：东西两侧的色带与箭头全部: Drag the SST anomaly to −2.0 ℃ (the 1973–74 La Niña): the color bands and arrows on both sides all reverse
东岸海温 19.5 ℃；东西温差 +10.0 ℃（比正常更大）；信风 7.50: East coast SST 19.5 ℃; contrast +10.0 ℃ (larger than normal); trades 7.50 m/s; eastern sinking stronger (−2.333), western rising stronger (+2.333); east coast rainfall −60.0 mm/month, west coast +60.0 mm/month; status "La Niña · very strong"
温差增大 · 信风更强（教材无拉尼娜图 · 本课示意）: Larger contrast · stronger trades (no La Niña figure in the textbook · illustrated by this lesson)
东旱西涝: Drought in the east, floods in the west
拉尼娜是中东部表层海水温度异常降低，与厄尔尼诺相反。: La Niña is an abnormal drop in central-eastern surface water temperature, the opposite of El Niño.
东西温差增大（+10.0 ℃）、信风更强（7.50 m/s）、东侧下沉更强（−2: The east–west contrast grows (+10.0 ℃), the trades strengthen (7.50 m/s) and eastern sinking strengthens (−2.333).
结果也相反：东岸更旱（−60 mm/月）、西岸更涝（+60 mm/月）。: The results are also opposite: the east coast is drier (−60 mm/month) and the west wetter (+60 mm/month).
去掉这一步：学生只认「暖事件」，考试里拉尼娜的符号一律写反。: Skip this step and students recognize only "warm events", writing every La Niña sign backward in exams.
易错：把拉尼娜的降水写反——拉尼娜时东岸更旱、西岸更涝（与厄尔尼诺相反）。: Common mistake: reversing La Niña's rainfall. During La Niña the east coast is drier and the west wetter (opposite to El Niño).
拉尼娜是赤道附近太平洋中东部表层海水异常降低；它使东西温差增大、信风更强、东侧下: La Niña is an abnormal drop in surface water temperature in the central-eastern equatorial Pacific; it enlarges the contrast, strengthens the trades and eastern sinking, making the east coast drier and the west wetter.
facts A2.3 #6、本章要点 7；B2.2 ②–⑧、B3 R6、B4 D: facts A2.3 #6, chapter key point 7; B2.2 ②–⑧, B3 R6, B4 D6/D10/D11/D12
考核：让东岸的下沉气流「刚好消失」: Check: make the east coast's sinking air "just disappear"
在曲线上找到那一点：东侧的下沉刚好消失（既不下沉、也不上升）: Find that point on the curve: where the sinking in the east just disappears (neither sinking nor rising)
达标的一组：海温异常 +1.5 ℃、涌升系数 1.00 → 东侧下沉 0.000: One passing setting: SST anomaly +1.5 ℃, upwelling coefficient 1.00 → eastern sinking 0.000, western rising gone, contrast +6.5 ℃, east coast rainfall +45.0 mm/month; other solutions are accepted too
「消失」是阈值点：东侧垂直运动为零，两端降水同时出现 ±45 mm/月。: "Disappears" is a threshold: vertical motion in the east is zero, and both ends show ±45 mm/month of rainfall anomaly at once.
越过它才出现上升，才会「由旱转涝」——教材的两句话是两个阶段。: Only beyond it does rising appear and "drought turns to flood"; the textbook's two sentences are two stages.
本课只用一个瞬时距平判定，不做持续性判定，也不设周期（教材说周期不固定）。: This lesson judges by a single instantaneous anomaly, without a persistence test or a period (the textbook says the period is irregular).
去掉这一步：学生把「减弱 / 消失 / 反向」当成一句话，看不出强弱档的意义。: Skip this step and students treat "weaken / disappear / reverse" as one phrase and miss the meaning of the strength levels.
考核：能说出「下沉消失」这一点，并解释它为什么不是「已经变成上升」。: Check: name the "sinking disappears" point and explain why it does not yet mean "rising".
东侧下沉「消失」的那一点就是海温异常 +1.5 ℃（课件设定）；再暖一点才转上升: The point where eastern sinking "disappears" is an SST anomaly of +1.5 ℃ (lesson setting); only warmer than that does it turn to rising, matching the textbook's "weakens or disappears, and rising air may even appear".
海洋提供大气水汽 87.5 %: The ocean supplies 87.5 % of atmospheric water vapor
海洋表层储存太阳辐射热量 85 %: The ocean's surface layer stores 85 % of solar heat

A1.3 ②#4（p.72）：南北赤道暖流是信风吹拂所形成的。: A1.3 ②#4 (p.72): the North and South Equatorial Currents are formed by the trade winds.
正常年份赤道太平洋的海温与气流是: In normal years, SST and air motion over the equatorial Pacific are
